title: Shapes with a tagged union
description:
Store different shapes in one type with an `enum` and a `union`.

```
circle r=1.00: area 3.14
rectangle 2.00x3.00: area 6.00
triangle base 4.00 height 3.00: area 6.00
total 15.14
```
hints: Only the member that matches `kind` holds a real value; reading another one is a bug (lesson 4.04).
Use `3.14159265358979` or `M_PI` if your system has it, for π.
requirements: `typedef struct { Kind kind; union { struct { double r; } circle; struct { double w, h; } rect; struct { double base, height; } tri; }; } Shape;`
`double area(const Shape *s)` and `void describe(const Shape *s)` with a `switch` on `kind`.
stretch: Add a `SQUARE` kind and a function that builds each shape (`Shape circle(double r)`).
